The '''Great Mother River Hotel''' was an expensive and elegant [[Hotel/Legends|hotel]], situated in [[Isttu Village]] aboard the [[Ithorian Herdship]] [[Bazaar (Ithorian Herdship)|''Bazaar'']]. Connected by skywalk to the [[Great Mother River Restaurant]], the hotel was a five-star establishment.
